<thought>We need the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition (break two C=C bonds, form two C‑C bonds). I will search the template catalog for templates that break a C=C bond and form a C‑C bond, then apply the most relevant template to the target molecule COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O to obtain all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "bonds_broken": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
